verdict.rationale: Pandoc's manual says it converts between Markdown, HTML, LaTeX and Word docx, with -f/-t format selection. Hands-on reports confirm Markdown↔Word conversion and proper header-to-style mapping. Fidelity caveats exist: Markdown round trips lose minor details, and one user reports butchered documents with a possibly older version. Missing for 10: any evidence of EPUB conversion, and independent confirmation of lossless round-trip fidelity across formats.

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other

citations.quote: Pandoc can convert between numerous markup and word processing formats, including, but not limited to, various flavors of Markdown, HTML, LaTeX and Word docx.
The input format can be specified using the -f/--from option, the output format using the -t/--to option.
Converts Word docs into Markdown so they can be diffed like source code.
Pandoc is the only one that consistently maps Markdown headers to real Word styles rather than just bigger fonts.
